text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A summer training camp to hone ability— As 
we rode the bus toward what Curren Chan 
called her "training grounds"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm checking it right now~. Sometimes 
new comments pop up on older posts too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking "I see," I copied her and looked 
back at all my previous posts once more, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's Umastagram was, as always, 
overflowing with sparkling, cute everyday 
moments.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
During the camp, I bet I can take some 
totally emotional, never-before-seen 
aesthetic photos!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Tell me right away if you think of 
anything, Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you think of anything, Big Sis, let me 
know right away, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lot of Umamusume push themselves hard 
during camp. As for what kinds of photos I 
could take there...
choice_data_list:
Like videos from your training or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, who knows? It's hard to stay in 
control while training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Every single photo Curren posts is 
carefully handpicked and approved by me, 
so only the cutest ones go up!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even when being filmed, she thinks a lot 
about how aesthetic it looks. But since I 
want to focus on training this time, maybe 
no videos~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in the middle of training, Curren 
Chan is plenty cute in my eyes... Though 
she surely has her own strict standards.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The beach is such an awesome location! I'm 
gonna take tons and tons of pics during 
our break♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You too, Big Brother! Don't miss the photo 
op, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You too, Big Sis! Don't miss this photo 
op, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like it's going to be a hot, 
cuteness-filled summer training camp.
